claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No magic_item kind exists in UnitRecord. types.ts only defines SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. The v4 taxonomy has magic_item_root but the surface schema has no corresponding record shape, mechanics header, or payload families for magic items.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Wondrous Item, Uncommon — As a Utilize action, you can throw the dust into the air...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: AreaOrigin: self_emanation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The dust creates a 30-foot Emanation originating from the user, not from a chosen point within range. AreaOrigin currently has point_within_range and on_primary_target. Neither is 'centered on self at cast time'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: forcing yourself and every creature in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition: incapacitated
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Condition type only defines 'prone'. Incapacitated is a standard SRD condition applied on a failed save. At minimum incapacitated (and likely all SRD conditions) must be added.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it has the Incapacitated condition and is suffocating

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Status: suffocating
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Suffocating is not a named SRD condition but a rules state (creature cannot breathe). It is a distinct mechanical status from Incapacitated and needs its own atom or surface variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: it has the Incapacitated condition and is suffocating

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SaveGate: creature_type_exemption filter
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Certain creature types (Constructs, Elementals, Oozes, Plants, Undead) auto-succeed on the save. There is no surface type for creature-type-based exemptions on save gates.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Constructs, Elementals, Oozes, Plants, and Undead succeed on the save automatically.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingEffect: repeat_save per turn
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The applied condition persists until the target succeeds on a CON save at the end of each of its turns. The v4 taxonomy has repeat_save as an atom, but there is no surface shape for per-turn repeat saves in either the spell or (nonexistent) magic item mechanics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectCure: named_spell_targets
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The effect ends if the creature is targeted by Lesser Restoration. There is no surface type for named-spell-as-cure triggers on ongoing conditions.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The effect also ends on any creature targeted by a Lesser Restoration spell.
